subject: general
question: According to the Census of 2011, which of the following is the third most populated urban agglomeration?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kolkata**__**.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the Census of 2011, Kolkata is the third most populated urban agglomeration.
 
• Kolkata was **ranked third **with a** population of 14.11 million** where the male population is 7,319,682 and the female population is 6,792,854.
 
• Census is conducted **every 10 years** by the Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner, India.
 
• It comes under the **Ministry of Home Affairs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• Urban Agglomerations:

 
 
• An urban agglomeration is a continuous urban spread constituting towns and their outgrowths.
 
• Here, outgrowths, maybe a village or groups of villages, hamlets or groups of hamlets with identifiable boundaries.
 
• The towns in an agglomeration are spatially contiguous to each other.
 
• An agglomeration shall contain at least one statutory town. 
 
• The population of the town shall be more than 20,000, according to the 2011 census.
 
• According to the 2011 census, there are around 475 urban agglomerations in the country.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• Mumbai

 
 
• It is the most populated city or urban agglomeration by population in India.
 
• It stood first with a population of 18.41 Million.
 
• In the year 2001, it was still the first with a population of 16.37 million.
 
 
 
• New Delhi is second according to the census of 2011 with a population of 16.31 million.
 
• According to the Census of India-2011, Chennai has the fourth-highest urban agglomeration population with a population of 8.69 million.
